relations.label: 'dul TIka 'thad ldan (4682) has as an instance ti ka 'thad ldan (8092)

comments:
Pp. 1-225 in vol. 1 of [BKB649FN].
Contains "dge slong gi rnam par 'byed pa gtan la dbab pa" (fols. 1-86) and "dge slong ma'i rnam par 'byed pa" (fols. 87-113). The latter is absent in (ID:4681).

An annotation on top of fol. 87a reports the view of "mnga ris pa." Annotations also identify some "kha cig" as "rgya" (probably rGya 'dul 'dzin dBang phyug tshul khrims (ID:3941)) and "sog" (likely Sog tshul khrims bla ma (ID:3940), Bya 'dul 'dzin's teacher). Also frequent are annotations "rma" (probably Bya 'dul's teacher rMa tsho Byang chub rdo rje (ID:3942)) and "cha" (the latter often below 'ti ka byed pa').
alternative_names: mdo' rtsa ba'i rnam bshad bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po shag kya'i dge slong brtson 'grus 'bar gyis mdzad pa (cover page)
name: ti ka 'thad ldan
item_description:
Folio numbering in both margins, in letters on the left, in cypher on the right (only up to 18).
Missing folio: 100 (or numbering mistake?).
Annotations by several hands.
Beginning and end of sections written in red ink, and portions of text highlighted in color.
